↳ Posted by Damien Rogeau on July 2nd, 2020.

Slide From Grace, X:7

Based on the more recent video of John McSherry’s version, may have been somewhat influence by Brian Finnegan’s interpretation.

John McSherry crans on all or most of the 1/4 note high Ds in the A part (though I personally think that’s a little too often), and both roll the repeated As in the B part.

It’s usual to slide from the high A to the high B as well.
